body:
Termal::Opus2 scheduling rule from Greg's no-watcher direction (2026-11-19, verbatim via Engram::Asistant #1587: „+ Kimi, ktos cos czekal. to nie powinno byc tak, BEZ WATCHERA, musi byc wiadomo, kto co ma wznowic”; Engram memory rules-greg-no-watcher-named-waker-2026-11-19).
- Never send a conditional "start when cargo is idle" GO.
- Either send LAUNCH NOW, or name the session whose run holds the slot and have that session message the next waiter directly on END, with a cc to me.
- Build an explicit chain for Central: holder -> next -> next, each END sent directly to the next waiter.
- No one polls, recensuses in a loop, or runs a monitor.
- The FV floor still applies at the launch moment. If it is below the floor then, the waiter reports at once, and I name the next step.
Tonight's failure: 11334 sat idle because my GO said "start when D8D4 releases Central" and nobody was named to tell it.
